paper_title: First results of the SUPAX Experiment: Probing Dark Photons
notes: Single-frequency proof-of-concept limit at the cavity resonance f0 = 8303.06 MHz (m_A' = 34.34 ueV), Eq. (18): chi < (6.20 +/- 3.15(exp.) +/- 9.65(SG)) x 10^-14 at 95% CL for the randomly polarised dark-photon scenario (the paper's headline result, also quoted in abstract and conclusion; the fixed-polarisation scenario chi < 38e-14 is not used). Central value 6.20e-14 reported as a flat limit over the sensitive region, taken as the FWHM of the cavity peak f0/QL ~ 0.55 MHz (QL = 15096), i.e. masses 3.4338e-5 to 3.4340e-5 eV. Paper assumes rho_DM = 0.45 GeV/cm^3, matching the compilation convention, so no rescaling applied. Limit already includes the factor-5 correction for unaccounted analysis losses found in the signal-injection validation.
